tc.subtitle: 深度營運與策略研究｜2026 年第三季業績專題
tc.source_line: 更新：2026/10/15｜季度截至 2026/09/30｜業績公布：2026/10/13。實績取自公司披露；預測及估值為 Bloomberg EEO 截圖快照。

views.title: 股票業務推升盈利，不能把高峰季度直線外推
views.text: 我們認為，本季核心亮點是客戶活動與融資能力帶動的收入增長。淨收入 US$18.679bn、年增 23%，攤薄 EPS US$17.01、年增 39%；股票業務收入年增 72% 至 US$6.441bn，明顯強於 FICC。惟集團收入與 EPS 分別季減 8% 及 19%，顯示交易收入仍有周期性。評估持續盈利時，應觀察融資餘額、客戶活動及投行落實量，而非把單季增幅直接年化。 公司亦披露慈善捐款令本季 EPS 減少約 US$1.00、ROE 減少約 1.1 個百分點。

views.title: 資產管理規模擴大，但收入質素仍須拆解
views.text: 我們認為，資產與財富管理是降低盈利波動的重要支柱。AUS 達 US$4.097tn，長期資產淨流入 US$97bn；管理及其他費用年增 22% 至 US$3.587bn。惟本季激勵費 US$587m 與基金分配有關，投資收入僅 US$50m。可重複的管理費與不固定的激勵費、投資損益應分開評價，規模成長並不等於每季都能複製相同盈利增幅。

views.title: 投行回升與風險資本消耗必須一併看
views.text: 我們認為，投行費用年增 21% 至 US$3.224bn，證明顧問及承銷需求有支持；但在手交易費用項目較上季下降，亦略低於去年底，不能據此假設下一季繼續加速。標準法 CET1 由 12.9% 降至 12.4%，信貸撥備升至 US$368m。增長、回購與風險加權資產之間的取捨，將比單一收入數字更影響股東回報。

views.title: 估值須與回報率及交易周期匹配
views.text: 我們認為，FY2027E 調整後本益比 11.98 倍、P/B 2.17 倍，反映市場仍給予高盛專業能力溢價。本季公司公布 ROE 為 18.7%，但持續性取決於交易、市場環境與資產管理收入組合。ANR 共識目標價 US$1,090.08 相對 US$878.72 有 24.1% 價差，屬整體分析師共識快照。

risks.title: 交易收入波動
risks.text: 股票及 FICC 業務受成交、波動率、融資需求及客戶風險偏好影響；收入的高基數令未來同比增長更具挑戰。

risks.title: 交易完成與費用變現
risks.text: 投行在手項目已較上季下降。交易延遲、監管審批及市場融資條件轉差，可能削弱顧問、承銷與激勵費收入。

risks.title: 信貸、估值與退出成本
risks.text: 批發貸款減值推高撥備，Apple Card 貸款組合減值拖累平台業務；資產出售時間與回收價仍可能影響盈利。

risks.title: 資本及回報率持續性
risks.text: CET1 季降 50bp 至 12.4%。風險加權資產上升、監管要求或盈利放緩，均可能壓縮回購空間及估值支持。

sc.subtitle: 深度运营与策略研究｜2026 年第三季业绩专题
sc.source_line: 更新：2026/10/15｜季度截至 2026/09/30｜业绩公布：2026/10/13。实绩取自公司披露；预测及估值为 Bloomberg EEO 截图快照。

views.title: 股票业务推升盈利，不能把高峰季度直线外推
views.text: 我们认为，本季核心亮点是客户活动与融资能力带动的收入增长。净收入 US$18.679bn、同比增长 23%，摊薄 EPS US$17.01、同比增长 39%；股票业务收入同比增长 72% 至 US$6.441bn，明显强于 FICC。但集团收入与 EPS 分别环比下降 8% 及 19%，显示交易收入仍有周期性。评估持续盈利时，应观察融资余额、客户活动及投行完成量，而非把单季增幅直接年化。 公司亦披露慈善捐款令本季 EPS 减少约 US$1.00、ROE 减少约 1.1 个百分点。

views.title: 资产管理规模扩大，但收入质量仍须拆解
views.text: 我们认为，资产与财富管理是降低盈利波动的重要支柱。AUS 达 US$4.097tn，长期资产净流入 US$97bn；管理及其他费用同比增长 22% 至 US$3.587bn。但本季激励费 US$587m 与基金分配有关，投资收入仅 US$50m。可重复的管理费与不固定的激励费、投资损益应分开评价，规模增长并不等于每季都能复制相同盈利增幅。

views.title: 投行回升与风险资本消耗必须一并看
views.text: 我们认为，投行费用同比增长 21% 至 US$3.224bn，证明顾问及承销需求有支持；但待完成交易费用项目较上季下降，亦略低于去年底，不能据此假设下一季继续加速。标准法 CET1 由 12.9% 降至 12.4%，信贷拨备升至 US$368m。增长、回购与风险加权资产之间的取舍，将比单一收入数字更影响股东回报。

views.title: 估值须与回报率及交易周期匹配
views.text: 我们认为，FY2027E 调整后市盈率 11.98 倍、P/B 2.17 倍，反映市场仍给予高盛专业能力溢价。本季公司公布 ROE 为 18.7%，但持续性取决于交易、市场环境与资产管理收入组合。ANR 共识目标价 US$1,090.08 相对 US$878.72 有 24.1% 价差，属于整体分析师共识快照。

en.subtitle: Operations & Strategy Research | 3Q2026 Earnings Special
en.source_line: Updated 15 October 2026 | Quarter ended 30 September 2026 | Results released 13 October 2026. Actuals are company reported; forecasts and valuation are supplied Bloomberg EEO snapshots.

views.title: Equities drive earnings; avoid extrapolating peak activity
views.text: We believe the quarter demonstrates the value of client engagement and financing capacity. Net revenue rose 23% to US$18.679bn and diluted EPS rose 39% to US$17.01; equities revenue increased 72% to US$6.441bn, well ahead of FICC. Revenue and EPS nevertheless fell 8% and 19% sequentially. Sustainable earnings depend on financing balances, client activity and completed deals; the year-on-year surge should not be annualized mechanically. Charitable contributions also reduced quarterly EPS by approximately US$1.00 and ROE by approximately 1.1 percentage points.

views.title: Asset growth improves resilience, but fee quality matters
views.text: We believe Asset & Wealth Management can diversify earnings. AUS reached US$4.097tn, long-term net inflows were US$97bn and management and other fees rose 22% to US$3.587bn. Yet US$587m of incentive fees reflected fund distributions, while investment revenue was only US$50m. Recurring management fees deserve separate treatment from episodic incentive fees and investment marks; asset growth does not guarantee the same profit growth every quarter.

views.title: Underwriting recovery must be weighed against capital usage
views.text: We believe the 21% increase in investment-banking fees to US$3.224bn supports the franchise case. However, the fee backlog declined from June and was slightly below year-end, weakening the case for automatic acceleration. Standardized CET1 fell from 12.9% to 12.4%, and provisions reached US$368m. The balance between growth, repurchases and risk-weighted assets will matter as much as headline revenue.

views.title: Valuation requires durable returns, not a target-price shortcut
views.text: We believe FY2027E adjusted P/E of 11.98x and P/B of 2.17x require sustained franchise returns. Reported quarterly ROE was 18.7%, but persistence depends on market activity and the wealth-management revenue mix. The US$1,090.08 ANR consensus target implies 24.1% price upside from US$878.72. This is the broad analyst consensus snapshot.

risks.title: Market-sensitive revenues
risks.text: Equities and FICC depend on volumes, volatility, financing demand and client risk appetite. A high revenue base makes future year-on-year growth harder.

risks.title: Deal completion and fee realization
risks.text: The investment-banking backlog fell sequentially. Delays, regulatory approval and weaker financing conditions could constrain advisory, underwriting and incentive fees.

risks.title: Credit, marks and exit costs
risks.text: Wholesale impairments raised provisions, and Apple Card loan markdowns depressed Platform Solutions. Exit timing and recoveries can still affect earnings.

risks.title: Capital and return durability
risks.text: CET1 fell 50bp to 12.4%. Higher risk-weighted assets, regulatory requirements or slower earnings could constrain repurchases and valuation support.
